//: Where local-only state is backed up (process.md section 1). The folder is the owner's private Google Drive folder; rclone does the transfer. rcloneAccount is any rclone Drive remote authorised for the owner's account - the folder is forced by folderId, so the remote's own root does not matter. A dedicated remote is better: rclone config create mandosdrive drive scope=drive root_folder_id=<folderId> (needs a browser login once), then set rcloneAccount to mandosdrive.

mandos-lab-data.what: the desktop lab build's data base: saves, graveyard and lineage (install storage in the browser profile), settings, logs
